sources.description: Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton met with the media on Saturday to talk about the ongoing rookie minicamp practices. However, one non-rookie has caught the eye of the Broncos head coach, and he went out of his way to hype them up. Payton was answering a question about how they decide which veteran players […]
